_what: Twelve problems drawn from the 31-beat review of 2026-09-26/27, each with what was measured, the user's own words where they named it, and what solving it unblocks or blocks.
_whyPlausible: Written by Claude from the export, the pool and the bindings. CLAUDE.md: "Claude's own reading is not evidence. Where a judgment is needed, it comes from a versioned prompt through the pipeline." Nothing here has been through one. The MEASUREMENTS are reproducible and the USER WORDS are verbatim; the problem statements, the ranking and the impact claims are analysis and may be wrong.

_withdrawn.claim: 0 of 40 beats name an artist with no media candidate
_withdrawn.why: The first pass built its name list from assets that already had media, so it could only ever return zero. Redone against the real gazetteer: 2 of 40, both Curren$y.

issues.title: Drake is added to every beat, whether the beat is about him or not
measured: 36 of 40 beats carry Drake in their entity list while the beat's own sentences never name him.
On those 36 beats, 367 of 708 media candidates are Drake.
On 13 beats every candidate is Drake.
Origin: the single field `_subject: Drake` in grammar/beat-entities.json, merged into all 40 beats.

userWords.words: drake has no place in the beat. this beat is about currensys songs/albums. currency album covers and songs artwork should be whats available to select from
templates are correct. drake being here is not
drake is only 1 of 93 artists that need to be in this scene

issues.unblocks: Slate space on 36 beats at once: ten Drake portraits stop crowding out the entities a beat is actually about. Cheapest of the twelve — one field, no model run.
issues.blocks: Cannot be a blind removal. Drake is the unnamed subject of much of the script; on 01-01 ("one rapper's catalog") he is correct and unnamed. Removing the subject everywhere empties those beats. The open question is when a subject is implied versus absent, which the pipeline never decides today.

issues.title: A beat that names a group resolves to nobody
measured: 11 of 40 beats refer to people by count or label rather than by name: 'ninety-three rappers', 'the 2010 class', 'the 2009 class', 'seven rappers', 'the next five artists', 'eighty-one of the ninety-three', 'eleven rappers under the rule'.
6 of those 11 resolve to exactly one entity (Drake) with 10 candidates, all Drake: 03-03, 13-13a, 13-13b, 14-14, 19-19, 22-22.
18-18 says 'stack all seven end to end' and resolves 3 of 7 — Drake, J. Cole, Nicki Minaj. Candidates: Drake 10, J. Cole 9, Nicki Minaj 12. The other four of the 2010 class have none.

The gazetteer is not at fault: only 2 of 40 beats name a roster artist with no media candidate, both Curren$y (01-01, 02-02b), measured against the 297-name grammar/entity-roster.json with word-boundary matching.

userWords.words: good template selections but need all the other contextual artists in this beat to be represented in media candidates too... where are they in the media selection and why aren't they here.
only drake images available. system should ask for images of the 93 rappers.
can't pair he second sentence, doesn't show the other artists images as available for selection. haven't been sourceed.

issues.unblocks: Eleven beats become pairable instead of impossible; six of them currently offer nothing usable. It is also the precondition for sourcing — a cohort nobody has enumerated cannot be requested.
issues.blocks: Gates PI-03. A spatial scene holds one marker per person, so offering it on a beat whose cohort is unresolved yields a template with nothing to fill it.

issues.title: Spatial scenes are gated by job binding, not by how many things the beat names
measured: 4 spatial/scatter templates are bound to any job. Three — 07_labeled_outlier_scatter, 23_portrait_scatter, 31_greatest_team_scatter — are bound ONLY to intersection_of_sets and locate_in_distribution.
Beat 03-03 is explain_the_encoding and names ninety-three rappers; it was offered 2 templates total, 1 of them spatial.
16-16, 18-18, 19-19, 20-20, 21-21a and 27-27 were offered zero spatial options despite all referring to cohorts.
CLAUDE.md already states a beat naming more than SPATIAL_MAX_SLOTS (20) things routes to spatial scenes only. That routing cannot fire for a job the spatial scenes are not bound to.

userWords.words: all spatial templates should be shown as options. period. make 20+ entities and any type of comparative / contrasting intentions be the condition to always show all spatial scenes as options

issues.unblocks: The only template family that can hold ninety-three things becomes reachable on the beats that need it. Cheapest fix to the cohort beats' template side — the templates exist and are already bound, just to the wrong jobs.
issues.blocks: Worth little before PI-02. A 93-slot field holding ten Drake photos is not progress.

All 11 archive3-vertical-cinematic-slideshow records are unbound. Their descriptions read 'Single portrait reveal, part N of 11, slow forward zoom' — a vertical carousel.

issues.title: Media eligibility has no per-template rules, so group photos reach spatial slots
measured: A spatial node is one marker per person; a photograph containing several people cannot be one marker, and nothing excludes it.
Eligibility today is framing and kind. Neither describes how many people are in the frame.

measured: Pairing requires a template plus at least one asset, so on a beat whose template gap is the problem the media judgement has nowhere to go.

issues.title: There is no numeric baseline, because the rating was never the tool the user used
measured: 0 of 31 review records carry a 1-5 rating. 28 of 31 carry prose notes.
The rating existed to answer the user's own framing on 2026-09-26: 'current state, we need to use this as how much we need to improve and where.' That measurement does not exist.
The notes carry more than a score would: the template wanted, the sentence it belongs to, and the missing media.
issues.unblocks: A before-and-after for every change in this list. Improvement can currently be argued but not shown, which the project's own measured-or-estimated rule refuses to accept.
issues.blocks: Do not solve it by asking for scores. 31 beats were reviewed in prose and the buttons skipped on all 31 — that is evidence about the instrument, not about compliance.
